limitations: Exp1 has 10 files and Exp2/Exp3 have 11, whereas the paper says each lane was cut into 12 slices; fraction numbers follow the workbook and gaps are not explained.
Heavy=treated and light=control are applied uniformly to all three experiments per the paper description; no per-experiment label-swap information was found.

Organism part, disease and sex come from Cellosaurus (HeLa), not from the deposit; Cellosaurus age (30Y6M) was not used and age is not available. Treatment values are free text and give ontology warnings.
Biological replicates 1-3 follow the workbook Experiment names Exp1-3 (one gel lane each); whether they are independent cultures is taken from the paper's 'three biological replicates' wording.
The deposit has no zip/tar archives; all run names claimed are deposited RAW file names.

Revised after review: tolerances (6 ppm / 20 ppm), CID and fixed carbamidomethyl Cys taken from the paper Methods. 'untreated' for light rows is the curator's wording for the control (paper also mentions an unspecific secondary antibody control elsewhere, context unclear).
